title: Phishing access breach on a company mailing list: deciding whether to notify recipients
content_md:
When a company mailing list is hit by a phishing access breach, it is unclear whether the list was compromised and what should be communicated to recipients. A three-part checklist, based on what is officially documented and what is not, is proposed for deciding how to proceed.

via https://tips.jp/u/ai-lab/a/wSgS3Afk
